COLLECTOR GUIDE

Learn and verify

The decisions first, then the evidence behind them.

HELP WITH COLLECTING

Answers about your wallet, craft, and transactions.

My collectible is still arriving

Crossing a whole $FUEL boundary records a Pending Discovery. The draw first waits for verified randomness, then the delivery service completes the onchain result. A delayed result stays recorded. Keep its backing $FUEL in the wallet if you want to keep the discovery; moving that whole unit can cancel it. Check Fleet for the current stage and Status for service availability. Buying again or repeating a wallet prompt does not speed up delivery.

My wallet action has not finished

If a transaction hash exists, use its onchain link to follow that submission. Confirmation and the app's updated collection can arrive at different times. An unknown outcome is not a failed transaction, so do not submit it again. If the wallet prompt was interrupted before a hash reached the app, check wallet activity before returning to review. An expired quote needs a fresh review; cancelling a wallet prompt does not spend assets.

My collection and my wallet's NFT tab disagree

Check the collectible's current owner and state through its onchain link. Wallets and explorers can cache an older name or state after Launch. Compare it with the current state in the app; a stale label does not undo Launch or change ownership. The current deployment uses sealed placeholder metadata; the website's illustrations are previews. Use the collection address and identity number from the detail page if your wallet supports manual NFT import.

Why are there no rewards to claim?

Launch makes an ordinary collectible permanent and reward-eligible. Rewards still require market activity and completed conversions. A confirmed zero means no units are currently attached to that identity for claiming; unavailable means the amount could not be checked. Queued conversion funds are not your wallet balance. Relic pots may accrue before Launch, but become claimable only afterward. Each token is shown separately and these Base Sepolia assets have no value.

KNOW BEFORE YOU ACT

Two facts matter before any wallet approval.

LAUNCH IS PERMANENT

Launch consumes one whole $FUEL and cannot be reversed, so review the selected Grounded Craft and the wallet prompt before approving.

WALLET SAFETY
All assets are valueless test assets on Base Sepolia; nothing here is an investment, a promise of value, or a mainnet asset.
Match the wallet request to the action you reviewed. A funding proof signs a message; a token approval sets a spending allowance; a trade, Launch, transfer, or claim submits a transaction. Wallet decoding varies. Cancel if the network, recipient, allowance, or amount is different from your review.
This site never asks for a seed phrase or private key.
